Setup in 30 Seconds

Link Your Computer Seamlessly

No phone numbers or passwords to re-type on desktop. Scan the encrypted QR code with your mobile app to link instantly.

1

Install & Open

Run the installer on your Windows, Mac, or Linux computer and open PingDart.

2

Open Mobile Settings

On your phone, tap Settings ⚙️ → Linked Devices → Link a Device.

3

Scan & Chat

Scan the QR code displayed on your desktop screen. All chats and files sync instantly.
